banner.title: The Dragon promotion batch four - issues 5 through 7 complete
banner.provenance: The content-structure arc round seven, the fourth rules promotion batch under the R968 format: eight records promoted mechanically from their spec JSONs into content/rules/dragon/ - issues 5, 6 and 7 complete (wch, cwx, wwt and wrm the Witchcraft Supplement rounds, dso and csx the Sea Trade issue, pwl and cpx the Prowler opener and its thin walk closer), 378 model items, every record parsed back and compared equal (the lossless proof). The batch sizing rides the raised ceiling (Curtiss, 2026-10-31): whole issue groups per round - this batch is 151832 bytes of Lua. Cumulative 23 of the walked 79-round Dragon set, 56 remaining.
